```{r}
#| include: false
 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  eval = TRUE
  , message = FALSE
)

# improve digit and NA display 
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = '')

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(hms)
library(readr)
library(sf)
#library(tmap)
library(viridis)
```


```{r}

fatalstormdata <- read.csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv")

```

```{r}


stormsimple <- fatalstormdata |>
  count(EVENT_TYPE, sort = TRUE)

g <- ggplot(data = stormsimple, aes(x = fct_reorder(EVENT_TYPE, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(color = EVENT_TYPE, fill = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(color = "none", 
         fill = "none")

g
```

```{r}

storm <- fatalstormdata |>
  select(YEAR, EVENT_TYPE) |>
  unite(storm, YEAR, EVENT_TYPE, sep = ",") |>
  count(storm) |>
  separate(storm, into = c("YEAR", "EVENT_TYPE"), sep = ",") 

g2 <- ggplot(storm, aes(x = EVENT_TYPE, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")

g2


```
